dslRule: $link.setText("" + $labelExpr + "") => java.lang.String resolutionText = $labelExpr.replace("&", "&&"); $link.setText("" + resolutionText + ""); ;;
summary: Transforms SWT Link.setText("" + label + "") to use a temporary variable that replaces single ampersands with double ampersands in the label, effectively disabling mnemonic processing for the link text. This prevents unintended underlines in UI elements.
